description: SECURITY (s440). Inside a SERVER function, a helper declared in the body wraps a PEER server-fn call and is used in a `.sort` comparator. `.sort` has no async combinator (DD colorless-async-boundaries FORK 2), so the comparator cannot await the helper: a bare emission hands `.sort` an always-truthy Promise per comparison. Before s440 the nested helper was invisible to the file-scope async sets, so this compiled silently. It now fails closed with the peer-server-fn code.
rationale: §13.2 requires `await` at every server call site. `inner` calls a peer server fn, so it is async, and its call in a synchronous comparator is a server call the compiler cannot await. §34 E-SERVER-FN-IN-SYNC-CALLBACK: a peer server-fn call in a position where the compiler cannot insert `await` is a hard, fail-closed compile error — reached through a nested helper exactly as through a direct call.
